scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config .cloudflare/wrangler.local.json && wrangler dev --config .cloudflare/wrangler.local.json --ip 127.0.0.1 --inspector-port 0
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && node scripts/configure-cloudflare.cjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .cloudflare/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy --config .cloudflare/wrangler.json
scripts.test:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config .cloudflare/wrangler.local.json && node scripts/smoke-cloudflare.cjs
